newsitem.title: MALAWI: Malawi 3-month T-bill rate drops to 19.83 percent.
newsitem.headline: Malawi 3-month T-bill rate drops to 19.83 percent.

text.p: BLANTYRE, June 9 (Reuter) The average discount rate for Malawi's three-month Treasury Bills dropped by 0.60 point to 19.83 percent at the latest fortnightly tender from 20.43 percent two weeks ago, the Reserve Bank said on Monday.
Applications for 218.80 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 184.05 million at the average price of 95.29 kwacha percent.

The average rate for six-month bills dropped by 0.71 point 20.83 percent from 21.54 percent two weeks ago. Applications for 128.33 million kwacha of bills on offer totalled 78.26 million at the average price of 90.58 kwacha percent.
For nine-month bills, no subscriptions were offered after an application for 111.44 million.
